subject.title: fix(ui): authenticate managed workspace image previews

question: Does the current managed-media URL validation contract guarantee that the reused authenticated fetch can only attach credentials to trusted Gateway media URLs returned for the requesting session?
rationale: The patch is intentionally narrow and its proof demonstrates allowed and denied behavior, but this credential-bearing UI path still needs an owner-level confirmation of the existing URL and session-binding contract before merge.

options.title: Confirm existing boundary
options.body: Review the existing managed-media classifier and Gateway route contract, then merge if they restrict authenticated fetches to trusted session-bound managed URLs.

options.title: Harden before merge
options.body: If the current classifier can accept an untrusted or cross-origin URL, restrict it to the canonical Gateway managed-media route and add a regression test before merging.

recommendation.title: Confirm existing boundary
recommendation.body: Review the existing managed-media classifier and Gateway route contract, then merge if they restrict authenticated fetches to trusted session-bound managed URLs.

likelyOwner.reason: They were explicitly routed into the early triage for this UI/Gateway authentication behavior, making them the best available review candidate from the supplied evidence.
